title: Verify error message when context length exceeds maximum limit
description: This test case is designed to verify if the correct error message is displayed when the context length exceeds the maximum limit of 8192 tokens
preconditions: The system should be up and running
steps: Send a request with a context length of 9518 tokens
expected_result: The system should return an error with message: 'This model's maximum context length is 8192 tokens. However, you requested 9518 tokens (5518 in the messages, 4000 in the completion). Please reduce the length of the messages or completion.'
assumptions: The system has a maximum context length limit of 8192 tokens

title: Verify no error message when context length is within maximum limit
description: This test case is designed to verify if no error message is displayed when the context length is within the maximum limit of 8192 tokens
preconditions: The system should be up and running
steps: Send a request with a context length of 8192 tokens
expected_result: The system should not return an error message
assumptions: The system has a maximum context length limit of 8192 tokens

title: Verify error message when context length is just above maximum limit
description: This test case is designed to verify if the correct error message is displayed when the context length is just one token above the maximum limit of 8192 tokens
preconditions: The system should be up and running
steps: Send a request with a context length of 8193 tokens
expected_result: The system should return an error with message: 'This model's maximum context length is 8192 tokens. However, you requested 8193 tokens. Please reduce the length of the messages or completion.'
assumptions: The system has a maximum context length limit of 8192 tokens
